description: Amber button that starts animating on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from inherit to #333333, text color changes from #fff to #FAC921, starts the chitchat animation (changing colour). On focus, background changes from inherit to #333333, text color changes from #fff to #FAC921, starts the chitchat animation (changing colour).
